                                 Assignment 1: Imitation Learning
                                        Due February 11, 11:59 pm


1     Introduction
In this assignment, you will train action chunking policies for the Push-T environment. You will first train a
simple MSE (mean-squared error) policy that predicts action chunks in a single forward pass. Then, you will
train a more expressive flow matching policy, similar to diffusion policy (Chi et al., 2025).
